name: Latent
description:
Latent is a control layer for AI, built on interpretability. It reads signals inside a model as it works and checks every answer and agent action in milliseconds. Then it lets the output through, holds it, re-asks a stronger model, or sends it to review with the reason attached.

Reading the model is far cheaper than running a second LLM, so it can check every step. Latent stops 99% of rule-breaking agents before they act, against 69% for a frontier LLM judge.

It works with self-hosted and API models like GPT, Claude, and Gemini, runs hosted or in your own cloud, and calibrates to your traffic with every review.

name: Verno
description: Every refinery, chip fab and power plant is built from thousands of engineering documents that are supposed to agree, and engineers still keep them in sync by hand. Verno is AI for how the physical world gets built. An engineer describes a change, and Verno edits the P&ID in the native CAD file, carries the change through line lists and other downstream documents, and checks every one against engineering rules before the engineer approves it. On drawings already issued for construction, it has caught errors like one tank with three different design pressures across three documents. We're starting with process EPCs in oil and gas, chemicals, semiconductors, pharma, and food and beverage, then expanding into water and power.

name: Moving Atoms
description:
Our first model, Atom 1, pre-trained on the internets video, and fine tuned for physics. 
It has been action conditioned, so you can simulate robot actions within it.
This lets Robot Labs train their robots using GPUs instead of relying on human collected manual data that is slow and expensive.
In unseen and hard to replicate environments, this is the only path to getting ANY training data.
verticals: Hard Tech, Robotics, Virtual Reality, Data Labeling, AI

name: Phone Harness
description: Phone Harness is the most popular open-source harness for phone automation with 3,800+ GitHub stars. We enable agents to tap, type, and scroll on your personal phone or cloud-hosted phones. Supports iPhone and Android. No jailbreak, API, or app installation needed.

name: Asterline
description: Asterline is a quantitative trading firm that builds automated systems to exploit pricing inefficiencies in prediction markets. We built proprietary backtesting infrastructure to rapidly discover, validate, and deploy new strategies at scale.

name: The Agentic Data Co.
description: We design and collect audio datasets for training speech models.

name: DeepMark
description: DeepMark is the authentication layer for AI voice. When an AI agent speaks, we embed a compact, machine-readable ID directly into the audio, not in metadata, which gets stripped the moment a file is touched. The ID resolves to a trust record, so a bank, a call center, or the person on the line can verify in real time who the agent is.

name: Open Actuation
description:
We design and manufacture high-mix drone motors and robotic actuators in LA.

DJI, Apple, and Ford don't settle for OTS components. Likewise, the teams that win the Western robotics market will build seamless machines from tightly integrated software and hardware. 

Open Actuation designs motors and actuators around your robot's unique form factor and mission - then we rapidly bring them to life with proprietary software and tooling geared for high-mix machining and assembly. We've designed and built motors for top drone OEMs and can assemble thousands of motors per month at our first factory in LA.

We're doing for motion components what 3D printing has done for structural components. This enables hardware teams to build and iterate at the speed of software so they can create elegant, reliable, ROI-positive robots and win massive markets.
verticals: Hard Tech, Robotics, Drones, Manufacturing, Electronics

name: Oasive
description:
Oasive is an AI research platform that helps municipal bond investors decide which bonds to buy.

Before a fund buys a bond from a city, school district, hospital or airport, its analysts spend hours digging through PDFs, board meetings and local news. Oasive brings a borrower's audited financials, debt, board meetings and local news into one page built around what matters for that sector, with every number linked to its source.

Built by a former bond portfolio manager at Google Treasury and quant analyst at Wells Fargo.

name: COACH
description:
85% of all sales still happen face-to-face. Coach is how those get closed.
Our AI turns in-depth sales conversation analysis into company knowledge and personalized coaching to help reps close more deals.
verticals: SaaS, B2B, Sales, Sales Enablement, AI

name: Mnemonic Labs
description: Mnemonic Labs (YC F26) is a neolab founded by two brothers who are Olympiad finalists and MIT graduates; Kalki made $20M in annual PnL at 22 at Tower and Videh was the youngest quant at Citadel at 19. Just as LLMs and scaling laws quickly dominated all other NLP approaches, we're building world models that will dominate both human and machine traders.

name: Databuddy
description:
Databuddy gives you your very own data analyst, always watching over your data, combining all your context to investigate and paint a full picture on every product issue that emerges in real-time; conversion drops, user frustration and churn.

It makes your product better without needing to have you look at a dashboard and spend hours figuring out the why. one click to install or switch from any dated analytics provider.
verticals: B2B, Analytics, Data Engineering, Infrastructure, AI

name: Redoubt Insurance
description:
Redoubt is building the autonomous insurance company, starting with commercial trucking. We’re automating the whole customer relationship: understanding each business, guiding insurance decisions and getting the work done.

Today we operate as a brokerage. We build capacity in software, with the goal of becoming an autonomous commercial insurance carrier.

name: Rodeo Robotics
description:
Rodeo Robotics (YC F26) automates vehicle maintenance so shops can get vehicles back to work at lower cost.

Co-founders Michael Hazard and Colby Duke met at Applied Intuition, where they helped OEMs like Toyota and General Motors deploy autonomy in the real world and saw firsthand how much hands-on work it takes to keep fleets running.

They’re now applying their experience to the $600B US maintenance market. The average vehicle is getting older and needs more maintenance, but shops struggle to recruit new technicians to replace experienced workers as they retire. This leaves shops turning away work and customers waiting longer for service.

Rodeo builds robots that inspect vehicles, diagnose problems, and perform services, starting with routine maintenance like oil and tire changes. Their robots use AI models specialized for multi-step vehicle maintenance tasks and operate autonomously for 96% of execution time on their initial tasks.

name: Confetti
description: Confetti lets anybody design and build hardware projects using plain-English prompts. Making hardware used to take weeks of learning CAD, sourcing compatible parts, and writing firmware. With Confetti, it takes one conversation. Create and edit designs, find components, and order printed parts straight to your doorstep. Start from scratch or remix a community project to make it your own.

name: Rapidfolio
description:
Rapidfolio helps banks and fintechs fully automate back-office workflows like fraud investigations, KYB/KYC and loan underwriting, with accuracy and auditability.

Built by fintech founders and operators, Rapidfolio is on a mission to ensure banks and fintechs scale their customer base without adding another back-office head count.

name: Volaren
description:
Volaren is the personal investing agent that comes to you. It knows why your portfolio moved, suggests your next idea, and trades it for you. 

Connect your bank accounts & brokerage and Volaren tells you what changed and why, answers any question about your money, and turns any idea into a trade. You can copy the moves of famous investors, politicians, proven strategies and themed baskets in a tap, or set up your own AI agents to watch the market and act within the limits you choose. 

Everything works from the app, the web or a simple text, so managing your money feels like texting a portfolio manager who never sleeps.

name: Cesara
description: Faster & accurate transactions for health systems

name: Dawn Industries
description: VIM connects to the entire cell: PLCs, robots, CNC machines, sensors. When a cell faults, VIM finds the cause, stages the fix, and the operator approves with one click. When a part drifts, VIM catches it seconds after the cut, inside the machine, and recommends the correction. Recovery drops from 30 minutes to under two, saving more than $15,000 per fault in large factories.

name: Ignition Benefits
description: Ignition is an AI-native employee benefits brokerage for companies with under 200 employees. Health insurance is one of the largest line items these companies carry, and employers absorb 15 to 40% rate increases year after year without ever seeing their own numbers. We have rebuilt the sales and back office to be AI-first. This market represents about $500B of market cap, and those businesses have not fundamentally changed in over 50 years. While scaling Plated, I wore every HR hat from doing payroll myself, to managing a PEO, to eventually hiring an employee benefits broker on our way to 1,500 employees. We wasted over $4M on benefits over 5 years, and I'm building Ignition to help companies under 200 employees avoid making my mistakes.

name: Shire Intelligence
description: Shire is an AI floor manager for full-service restaurants, running on the cameras they already have. It sees what a great manager sees: a guest ready to order, a table waiting on the check, a four-top that needs clearing, a server that is double booked. Then it acts, alerting staff in the moment and seating each new party with the server who has room. A POS only knows what gets typed into it. Shire knows what is happening in the room, so wait-time quotes, staffing, and pricing run on real turn times.

name: Manifold
description:
The US Warehouse industry spends $75bn on labor each year. Yet, only 10% of US warehouses have any form of automation, because existing robotics are too expensive and hard to integrate. 

Manifold deploys autonomous robots that handle picking, loading / unloading, and palletizing — priced by pick. Integration in hours. No upfront costs. No retrofitting. No need to rebuild the operation around the robot. 

Our mission is to make it easy for any warehouse to adopt robotics.
verticals: Hardware, Warehouse Management Tech, Robotics, Logistics, Supply Chain

name: Streamline Systems
description:
Streamline Systems is building the replacement for GPS. 

Satellite positioning has become the single point of failure for almost every modern system, both military and civil. We've built the replacement. A drop-in module that integrates with existing Ardupilot, INAV and PX4 flight controllers, with demonstrated satellite-independent autonomous flight and GPS handoff. 

We have secured over $80k in contracted revenue to supply our navigation modules for the Pentagon's $1.1bn Drone Dominance Program.

name: Hemlock
description: At Hemlock, we equip workers around the globe with EMG wearables to generate force/contact-annotated egocentric video data to give physical AI models a sense of touch from human data. Force + contact dynamics, collected at scale.

name: Nxtcure Labs
description:
NxtCure Labs is an AI-native, full-stack CRO built to take therapeutics from discovery to market faster. We are reinventing medicine from lab to drug discovery.

About 2 million Americans are diagnosed with cancer every year. Science has never moved faster, new immunotherapies, targeted drugs and cancer vaccines arrive every year. But roughly 90% of cancer drugs fail in clinical trials, and about 80% of trials run late. The breakthroughs exist. The way we test them is stuck in the last century.

NxtCure is building autonomous clinical trials. Before a single patient enrolls, we run the trial thousands of times on digital twins. Each virtual patient is a system of coupled differential equations that track how a drug moves through plasma, tumor and heart, and how the tumor grows, shrinks or fights back. The parameters are fit to real trial data, so every twin behaves like real biology. Across thousands of simulations we can calculate the odds that a dose will hit its endpoints, and fix the protocol before it costs anyone time, money or hope.

Then 13 AI agents run the trial. Each one owns a stage: drafting the protocol, ranking sites, pre-screening patients, forecasting drug supply, watching for adverse events, predicting dropout, cleaning data and writing the final report. As real data comes in, the twins update and flag problems weeks before a human would see them.

In 2025, the FDA laid out how computer simulation can take its place. Soon a cancer drug will run through thousands of simulated trials before it ever touches a lab, and reach patients years faster. We’re building that future.

name: MusicArena
description: https://musicarena.io/

name: Clean
description:
Agents can run outreach on their own now.

In manufacturing, insurance, defense and banking, buying runs on a clock. Every deal has a transaction window almost nobody can see. Reach out before it opens and nobody answers. After it closes, the deal's gone.

Clean finds that window and gives agents and sales teams the strategy to win the deal.

We're building the revenue intelligence every sales agent will run on.

name: Yam
description: Yam simulates a Love Island–style dating experience for women, starring their favorite characters. Avg playtime per DAU is 3+ hrs!

name: Synapse Semiconductor
description:
We want to push machines to where humans cant go. 
Presidential early career award winning Duke Semiconductor ECE Faculty Tania Roy and Sanjeev Chauhan are building a frontier semiconductor research lab. Their focus is on solving physical AI challenges from the semiconductor device level and building products around the moat of impossible to copy innovation. Their first work is on a new vision sensor that can run neural network filters right in the camera pixels and only collect data that machines care about. As physical AI develops, machines needs to understand the world around them if they aim to interact with them.
verticals: Edge Computing Semiconductors, Hard Tech, Robotics, Defense, AI

name: Donkey
description:
Donkey is the AI-native trading company. Upload a buying list and we land the whole container at one locked, delivered price, tariffs included. You buy from Donkey: one contract, one company responsible for everything between the factory floor and your door. Our own people check the cartons before the factory gets paid, and the balance is due when the goods are accepted at your dock.

Small businesses buy imports through three or four middlemen, each adding 15 to 30 points, because none of them can fill a container on their own. Big enough to buy pallets, never big enough to buy the box. Quotes float with freight, FX and tariffs and live 15 to 30 days.

A trading company is rooms of people on the phone with factories, forwarders and brokers. Donkey runs that as one engine. It finds the real factory behind the customs record, stacks duty line by line, packs the container on weight and cube, and returns one number that holds from signature. Next comes the shared container: small buyers fill one box together at container prices, and every container earns better factory terms for the next one.

Team in San Francisco and Wuhan, English and Mandarin. If your business buys pallets of anything imported, send us your buying list.

name: Axonnic
description: Axonnic is building the missing data layer for dexterous robotics. Our wearable EMG technology captures human intent, effort and force directly from muscle activity as people demonstrate physical tasks. By revealing the physical signals that video cannot capture, Axonnic gives AI models the data they need to learn more precise and dexterous behaviour. Beyond robotics, this creates a foundation for new forms of human–computer interaction in which technology can understand and respond directly to human movement and intent.

name: Helios Intelligence
description:
Helios is building a molecular body test from a single drop of blood. Our at-home test measures more than 1,000 biomarkers and turns them into a living model of the body—designed to show what is happening now, surface risk earlier, and become more useful with every test.

By combining longitudinal molecular data with labs, wearables, health records, and outcomes, we are building toward a world model of human biology. Our goal is to simulate all of human health and use that intelligence to help people perform, recover, and live longer.
verticals: Health Tech, Consumer, Diagnostics, Health & Wellness, AI

name: SubVysion
description: We build centimeter-accurate 3D maps of underground utilities to help construction contractors dig safer and faster. With underground intelligence, contractors can avoid dangerous utility strikes and costly project delays.
verticals: Hard Tech, Computer Vision, Real Estate, Construction, Infrastructure

name: Enact
description: Enact creates the physical environments to benchmark and hill climb robotics models on high-value tasks. We find where robots fail, and fix them with our in-house training loop.

name: Bayworks
description:
Bayworks captures how expert technicians fix cars and uses that knowledge to guide every technician through diagnosis and repair in real time, and to automate the admin work that follows.

This knowledge grows with every repair captured, across every car model and technician. Next, it will guide robots through the same repairs.

In four months, we have gone from zero to nearly seven figures in cARR, across 6 dealership groups including a top-50 US dealer ($3Bn annual revenue), and have powered over 50,000 repairs.

name: AnyAlpha
description:
AnyAlpha is the agentic trading platform. It turns your trading idea into an agent that trades it for you, 24/7.

Start with an idea. AnyAlpha builds the agent on institutional-grade data, backtests it on historical data, and trades it live on multiple exchanges. We're starting with prediction markets, with more asset classes to follow.

We signed Kalshi’s first and only partnership for agentic trading. AnyAlpha has reached 1,000+ active traders and over $1M in weekly trading volume since we launched trading in October.

name: Allia Health
description: Allia is the first full-stack, AI-native clinical group for mental health. We bring independent practices into one national clinical group that can deliver, measure, and improve care at scale .

name: WonderTx
description:
We’re an AI-native biotech, working on replacing needles with pills. Many drugs, like insulin or Ozempic, are wonderful except you have to inject them. We discover new molecules that you can take as a pill instead. Because the pills operate on biology which has been shown to be effective in people, rather than merely in animal models of disease, we avoid what has historically been the single biggest risk in drug discovery.  This should dramatically increase our probability of success.

There’s $200B of treatable diseases and validated human biology without a pill because discovery programs lack a tractable chemical starting point. This is a zero-shot inference problem, because these targets have no training data, so LLMs and other historical interpolative AI approaches are insufficient. Instead, we are building our own extrapolative frontier models that reason beyond their training data. Most critically, we have repeatedly validated our platform on both our own and partner programs. On 4 biologically- and structurally-diverse targets where we had zero training data, we successfully picked binders that were validated experimentally, with confirmation ranging from primary screen hits to crystallographic structures.
verticals: AI-powered Drug Discovery, Generative AI, Biotech

name: Verdun
description:
Traditional security camera monitoring is vaporware. Your sites aren't actually being protected. 

A monitoring center's video alarm queue is managed by operators who are flooded by alarms during peak activity - meaning it often takes 20+ minutes for them to even see your alarm.

When you call an airline and get placed on hold for a long time only for an offshore operator to tell you he can't solve your problems, this is the security equivalent. 

We've built the world's most advanced monitoring center run by AI agents identify threatening behavior and context before escalating to our highly trained professional operators to dispatch guards and police.

name: ByteAsk
description: ByteAsk is an AI coding agent built for C and C++, the code that runs trading systems, cars, chips, and operating systems. It does not stop at a diff that looks right. ByteAsk builds, debugs, and tests every change with the real toolchain until the change holds. If the compiler, the debugger, or the tests can catch it, then ByteAsk catches it too. It runs from the terminal or inside VS Code, Neovim, and Emacs, and is available fully on-prem.
verticals: Developer Tools, Open Source, Enterprise Software, AI

name: Kanopy
description: Video to automatically identify risks and condition on power lines, pipelines, rail, and other types of infrastructure over hundreds of miles at once.

name: Synara
description:
Security cameras don’t stop crime. They film it. Traditional monitoring does one job: watching an empty site after hours. It misses anything more complex, and anything that happens during the day. When something does happen, it sends an alert and leaves the response to you.

Synara is the AI monitoring station for the cameras that are already installed. It needs no new hardware and watches day and night. It understands far more than intruders: falls, guns, fights. And it owns the response. Synara verifies incidents in seconds, talks intruders down on site or sends police a verified alarm, then coordinates with officers on who’s on site and where people are safe, until the insurance claim is resolved.

Because AI does the watching, monitoring becomes drastically cheaper and more accurate. Synara sells through security integrators under their own brand, so every camera they’ve installed becomes recurring revenue.
verticals: Deep Learning, Security Orchestration, Automation and Response (SOAR), Monitoring

name: Aviern
description: Aviern makes unmanned cargo airplanes for commercial operations and defense logistics. In 2 months we built our own scaled aircraft that taxis, takes off, flies and lands fully autonomously and are working on a larger 50lb aircraft.

name: Wingman Law
description: Wingman Law is an AI-native personal injury law firm. Attorneys lead a team of AI agents to recover compensation for people injured in accidents. We are solving the human bottle neck in personal injury.

name: Veltha
description:
Veltha is the AI native TPA starting with workers comp. We handle claim for insurance providers end to end.

Learn more at https://veltha.ai

name: antimattr
description:
antimattr is building the hardware interface for human–agent interaction: an AI wearable system made up of a smart ring and voice-isolating earbuds.

Voice is the fastest way to instruct an AI agent, but most people won’t use it in public because it’s noisy and unreliable. We think voice AI adoption is held back by hardware, not by model quality.

The earbuds use our proprietary voice isolation to capture your voice clearly anywhere, whether that’s a loud pub, a factory floor or a busy street. That means clear calls and dictation/transcription you can trust.

The ring is a discreet way to control your agents. Tap to capture a thought, trigger a workflow, or record/summarise a conversation into a searchable personal memory.
verticals: Hard Tech, Hardware, Consumer, AI, AI Assistant

name: Tarifflo Inc.
description:
Tarifflo is the modern ABI, built for the AI agent era.

Legacy ABI software was built for people keying entries into screens. Tarifflo is built for code and agents. Every part of customs work is an API call: create entries from documents, classify every line to HTS, fill PGA records, apply Chapter 99 duties, transmit to CBP and track status through liquidation.

Your agents can file customs. Connect Claude or any MCP client and it prepares full entries using the same API. You review and approve, and Tarifflo files under your own filer code. Developers get REST and webhooks. Everyone gets one key, one meter and one bill.

Under it all is the same engine: live tariff intelligence covering every HTS code, Chapter 99 program, exclusion and rate change. The duty you file going forward is as right as the duty we audit looking back. 1 in 8 products we audit is overpaying, and if you overpaid on past entries we find it and file for your refund.

name: Arbital
description:
Arbital lets you trade perps, memes, stocks, and run market-making strategies from one place. In our first 7 months, 2,700 traders have traded $1.35B in volume through Arbital, and we're now doing $435M/month. 

We're building towards a social, mobile-first trading app that brings tokenized equities, crypto, and perps to everyone.
verticals: Fintech, Crypto / Web3, Investing, Trading, AI

name: Radley
description:
Radley is the first AI-native radiology practice. We're acquiring a radiology practice bringing Radley to $4.6M in annualized revenue and rebuilding it with agents from the ground up.

Radiology is already in crisis: there aren't enough radiologists to interpret 1 in 6 medical scans. In 10 years, that gap is growing to 1 in 3 - 246M scans a year.

From past experience, we know that point solutions won’t cut it. While there is demand (we have $2.2M in contracts to prove it), bottleneck isn't just software, it's outdated systems and slow, inefficient operations. That's why we own the full stack, clinical and operational, end to end.

We met at Carbon Health as we scaled operations 31x and expanded to 100+ clinics. Now we're rebuilding radiology.

name: Earendil Robotics
description:
Earendil Robotics builds cUAS solutions for the modern warfighter, enabling effective air defence at the small-unit level. We deliver spotting, engaging, and destroying capabilities through advanced sensors, autonomous interceptors, and integrated systems.

Our product lineup covers every stage of the kill chain, complemented by the Drone Warfare Academy that trains soldiers to eliminate enemy drone threats in contested environments.

Backed by worldwide frontline combat experience, we equip units with combat-proven tools to counter evolving aerial threats.

name: Ultrasonium
description:
The technologies that define this century, including data centers, rockets, satellites, and robots, are built from complex metal parts. As these systems advance, the parts get harder to make. Past a certain complexity, casting and machining stop working, and the advanced methods that remain are slow, expensive, and hazardous.

Ultrasonium has invented a new manufacturing method to make these critical parts 15x faster and 75% cheaper than the methods they replace, in the U.S. and at scale. Solid metal feedstock goes in and a finished part safely comes out, controlled by a physical AI layer and novel control processes. 

The systems that matter most, in aerospace, energy, and compute, are demanding metal geometries that can't be machined or cast and are too expensive and slow to make with incumbent methods, at a moment when domestic manufacturing capacity is a national priority.

Our founding team has built and innovated some of the most complex engineering systems known to man: quantum computers, superconductors, nuclear reactors, and novel aerospace alloy processing methods.

name: Avoca Systems
description: Avoca is the AI patient access platform built for radiology. It integrates with a network’s existing systems and operational knowledge to automate calls, online scheduling, faxes, e-referrals and patient communications, from referral through to results and follow-up. Unlike generic scheduling tools, Avoca understands the clinical, operational and resource constraints behind every radiology booking, helping providers capture more demand, reduce administrative work and fill more scan capacity.

name: Reconero
description:
Officers join the force to protect their communities, yet over 40% of their day is eaten by paperwork that keeps them behind a desk. The burden reaches beyond lost time. Burnout is driving officers out of the force, leaving those who remain carrying an even heavier workload.

Reconero is built to give that time back. By automating reports, forms, analytics, and more, we help officers finish their administrative paperwork faster, spend more time serving their communities, and protect the time they have with their families.

name: Limnion
description: Limnion is building an open-standards telemetry storage platform for observability at scale, including agentic workflows. Siglake is the open-source project that sits at the heart of it, designed around OTel, Parquet, and Iceberg. No proprietary storage, no vendor lock-in.

name: Altair Health
description:
Altair is an AI-native medical billing service for independent practices. We take over a practice's billing end to end and get doctors paid by insurers. AI does the work; our billers handle the exceptions.

That can only work if a practice can trust an agent alone with its revenue. So we formalized insurers' billing policies and put a theorem prover under the agent. Before the agent acts on a claim, the prover checks the action against that insurer's policies, and anything that fails goes to one of our billers. 

Every claim teaches Altair how each insurer behaves, so the longer we run a practice's billing, the better we predict what its insurers will pay, deny or delay.

We're building the default way a new practice gets paid: a doctor connects their EHR and bills clean, completely self-serve and on auto-pilot.

Altair will be the financial platform every independent practice in America starts on and stays on. And to the Health Insurers' "Delay, Deny, Defend", we say "Predict, Prevent, Prevail".

name: Trident
description:
Trident is the standard for modern day security. its an agentic pentester that chains vulnerabilities together like a real attacker mapping verified attack paths across AWS, Azure, GCP, web apps, and APIs. Run AI attacks and get fixes.

Get started today: tridentsecurity.io

name: Ryhla
description: Ryhla develops proprietary models that replicate the distribution power grid and learn what gets a project connected. We work with solar/battery, EV charging and small data center developers.
verticals: Solar Power, Climate, Energy, Renewable Energy, Infrastructure

name: Mendelia

name: ORO AI
description:
ORO AI is an applied AI research lab building high-fidelity simulation environments to teach AI to run autonomous businesses. We ground these simulation in real data to teach AI the tacit knowledge required to run safe and profitable businesses.

Our first public benchmark, SMB Bench, puts a frontier model in charge of a produce wholesaler's buying desk for a simulated 90-day quarter, where shortages and supplier failures have delayed effects. The report, leaderboard and every run are available: https://oroagents.com/benchmarks/smb-bench

SMB Bench is a step toward our longer-term goal of having AI as an independent economic actor.

name: ObsessionDB
description: ObsessionDB is a real-time data warehouse that makes your data stack agent-ready. Your agents can ingest and query vast amounts of data in seconds, without the scary infra bill. Powered by our own more efficient fork of ClickHouse®.

name: Vernius Systems, Inc.
description:
We make mass-deployable radars for unmanned systems. Our first product is Archimedes, a radar seeker that finds and locks onto targets, enabling autonomous intercept on any drone. We have over $580M in LOIs for Archimedes, across some of the largest defense primes in Ukraine, the EU, and the Middle East.

Seekers are the most critical and costly component in every autonomous interceptor. Developing a radar seeker takes a 200+ person team at Raytheon and hundreds of millions of dollars. Archimedes is 100x cheaper than existing radar seekers on the market - and is the first product to make it feasible to deploy radars on every drone.
verticals: Hard Tech, Drones, Radar, Aerospace, Defense

name: Capveon
description: Turning infrastructure demand into action

name: Vyra
description: Instead of making users learn a timeline, we let them upload footage, describe what they want, and get back a polished edit in minutes.

name: The Subvocal Company
description: The Subvocal Company builds glasses that use radio-frequency sensing to turn silently mouthed words into text, replacing voice AI and keyboards as the next interface between humans and AI. Our launch on X reached 12M+ impressions and we've collected >$150k in preorder deposits from customers.

name: IMPACT Drones
description: IMPACT builds autonomous interceptor drones that ship in sealed containers. The box sits at the site it protects, data centers, power grids, airports, bases, with no crew on the pad. When sensors cue a hostile drone, an interceptor pierces its own frangible lid, launches, and rams the target, guided by onboard vision that keeps working when GPS is jammed. Legacy effectors cost $1M+ per shot against $30k threats; ours cost less than the threat and scale with the swarm, the same class of interceptor already downing Shahed drones over Ukraine. Sites subscribe to protection instead of buying missiles, hardware, reloads and monitoring included: Air Defense as a Service. 180M+ USD in signed letters of intent.

name: Caladh
description: Caladh protects critical maritime infrastructure from drone attacks above and below the waterline.  Our systems detect, track, and defeat unmanned systems so they can't get near the assets they want to disrupt.
verticals: Hard Tech, Hardware, Drones, Maritime, Defense

name: TareBio
description: Our platform develops personalized or population-level vaccines for any disease in weeks by changing only one input: the immune imprint. Instead of trying to predict which antigens might work, we read out immune cells already fighting the disease in the body and reverse-engineer antigens that activate them. We've already run our platform end-to-end and created a vaccine that cured cancer in mice.

name: Omanta
description:
Omanta is a personalized research lab for patients who have exhausted standard options, want to prepare proactively for recurrence, or are living with an unresolved diagnosis.

We direct the full operational infrastructure, personnel, expertise, and technology of a large research program toward understanding and addressing the challenges of individual patients across oncology, rare disease, and undiagnosed conditions.

For clinicians, we act as a collaborative partner, providing a living roadmap for ongoing patient care built on a rigorous and evolving scientific evidence base.

We fully operationalize patient-specific research programs, covering tissue logistics, diagnostic follow-up, data integration, multiomic analysis, therapeutic strategy development, and more.

Omanta brings context and clarity to complex cases, helping clinicians see more of the scientific picture as they decide how best to care for their patients.
verticals: Digital Health, Healthcare, Health & Wellness, Oncology, AI

name: Gamgee
description:
​Gamgee began with Rosie, founder Paul Conyngham’s dog. After surgery, chemotherapy and immunotherapy failed, Rosie was given months to live. Paul used AI and genomic analysis to identify targets in her tumour, then worked with scientists at UNSW to produce what is believed to be the first fully computationally designed mRNA cancer vaccine delivered to a dog. Following treatment, several tumours shrank significantly and her quality of life improved

Gamgee is building an end to end platform for personalised mRNA cancer vaccines for dogs. We sequence a dog’s tumour and healthy DNA, identify mutations unique to its cancer, and design a vaccine that teaches the immune system what to attack. We manage the entire process- from vet intake and tissue collection through genomic analysis, vaccine production, treatment and response monitoring

​We are now turning that one off effort into a repeatable clinical system. Gamgee is running clinical trials in Australia, working with vets, oncologists and specialised laboratories, and accepting cases globally. Our goal is to make personalised cancer treatment accessible to every dog that needs it- and use each case to improve the treatment for the next

name: Tesser
description:
Tesser is a cloud development runtime that lets developers run multiple dev environments in parallel without overloading their laptops.

Our CLI moves workloads like servers, builds, tests, and typechecking to isolated cloud machines while developers continue using their existing editors and coding agents. Tesser handles provisioning, networking, and port forwarding. Teams can access each other's environments through our gateway, share live previews, and run Tesser on our infrastructure or their own cloud (BYOC).

name: Odin Robotics
description: Odin Robotics deploys robot arms in small and mid-sized factories to do repetitive manual work, like machine tending and packing. They work alongside existing machines and people, so factories don't have to redesign their lines. With deterministic controls and learned skills, they're both reliable and flexible.

name: Taan.ai
description:
Taan builds foundation music models that do what you tell them to, when you tell them to. We're starting with music for video. Give Taan a video and it watches it, then composes an original score that follows the emotion and timing of every cut. If the scene is tense for 10 seconds and then turns happy, the music changes at that exact moment. You get back a fully mixed .mp4. Agents and apps call Taan through our API, so any video tool can add scored, synced music with one call. 

Today's music models can make catchy tracks, but you can't steer them. Ask for "violin at exactly the 11th second" and they usually skip it. We trained Taan from the ground up for control. 

We measured Taan on prompt adherence and instruction success. And against every leading model we tested, Taan was at least 4x better.  

We work with teams building video agents, ad and creative tools, micro-dramas and games. We're musicians and ML researchers. Adithya (CEO) comes from eight generations of Indian classical musicians, tours as a metal guitarist, has done music ML research since 2023, and has filed two patents on music generation architectures. Devansh (CTO) did signal-processing research at IIT Kanpur and was previously an ML engineer at American Express.

name: LinkLane
description: LinkLane helps businesses move freight with a click. Anyone can get a quote and book instantly, while our AI agents find the carrier, negotiate the rate, and manage every load from pickup to delivery. Trucking is a nearly $1 trillion market still run by call centers of brokers working the phones. We're bringing the Amazon experience to freight, making shipping cheaper and easier for every business.
verticals: Digital Freight Brokerage, Marketplace, Workflow Automation

name: Halmos Labs
description:
The drug development pipeline is built around humans. Other AI biotech companies build automation around the established infrastructure. Halmos Labs rebuilds the infrastructure around automation. The central bottleneck is access to experiments. Halmos Labs platform physicalvalidation.com connects agents to biolabs across the globe in days rather than weeks. 

Using physicalvalidation.com, Halmos research agent is continuously designing drugs and has so far designed and tested a new mRNA cancer vaccine and a new antibiotic with results December 10th.
verticals: AI-powered Drug Discovery, Auto Commerce, Swarm AI, Biotech, Automation

name: Pennant
description: Led by former institutional proxy voters and technologists with a collective 20+ years of experience, Pennant gives institutional investors, public companies, and corporate advisors voting and governance intelligence to act on their own principles at scale.

name: Ethos Space Resources
description: Ethos makes silicon on the Moon to power terawatt scale data centers. The Moon's surface is 21% silicon. We melt and electrolyze the lunar surface to make raw materials for solar panels. With solar panels made from the Moon, the constraint that limits data center scaling and everything else in space is gone.
verticals: Hard Tech, Exascale Computing, Energy, Aerospace, Industrial

name: Polemos Industries
description:
Precision strike is rationed. Forces see more targets than they can afford to hit.

Polemos builds AI-guided ballistic missiles and the compact launchers that fire them, designed for mass manufacturing. Our launchers form a strike network wired into the recon drones already in the sky: a drone geolocates a target, the nearest launcher fires, and a guided round lands in seconds.

Short range, no wasted kilometers, no modified trucks. Built on production lines that already exist, so output scales when it matters most.

name: Rhem Labs
description: Rhem Labs builds smart home care devices that help older adults and people with complex care needs live independently.

name: Trepo
description:
Trepo is building agents that shop for you, starting with groceries.

To know what your household needs, a shopper has to understand what happens at home. Today, that information is scattered across cupboards, receipts, recipes, and the people living there, leaving one person to remember what’s running low, what needs using, and what’s for dinner.

Our Kitchen Assistant and connected app help households track their food, decide what to cook, and use what they already have. A shared device lives in the kitchen, where groceries are unpacked, meals are prepared, and leftovers are saved. That makes it easy to keep Trepo informed as those things happen, giving our agents the context to understand what your household needs and buy it for you.

We’re starting with food. Our ambition is a home that knows what it has, what it needs, and what to do next.

name: Ailit
description:
Ailit is building the electric energy system for North American freight rail. Our first product, Superwagon, is a battery wagon designed to power existing diesel-electric locomotives, allowing railroads to electrify the fleets they already own.

Superwagon carries swappable battery packs that supply electricity to the locomotive’s existing electric motors. Discharged packs are exchanged for charged ones along the route and recharged off-board, providing operators with limitless range.

We deliver energy as a service, owning and operating the batteries and swapping sites. Railroads pay for energy with no upfront equipment purchase, with pricing set at 20% below today’s diesel cost.

Founded in Stockholm by Christian Lind and Emil Tagesson, our team is now based in San Francisco. We’re building our first full-scale prototype, and it’s being prepared to move a locomotive on battery power in the coming days.
verticals: Hardware, Transportation, Energy, Electric Vehicles, AI

name: Aerogen Systems
description:
We are building the future of chip manufacturing.

Chips are more advanced than ever, and the features inside them keep getting smaller. But the cleanroom infrastructure supporting their manufacture has not scaled at the same pace. Intel, TSMC, Samsung, and others spend billions building and operating massive cleanrooms, only to isolate their most advanced wafers from the surrounding facility as much as possible.

We think that architecture is backwards. Instead of making the entire building cleaner, why not make the machinery itself as clean as possible?

Talos is our proprietary tool-integrated purification system. It sits directly inside semiconductor equipment and continuously destroys airborne molecular contaminants before they reach the wafer. Instead of fighting contamination by constantly flooding tools with ultra-high-purity nitrogen, Talos keeps the environment inside the machine 10–100x cleaner, without the massive purge-gas bill.

Talos is powerful on its own, but it is also the foundation for a much bigger vision: the Cleanpipe.

The Aerogen Systems Cleanpipe is an ultra-clean interconnect infrastructure that protects wafers as they move from machine to machine across the fab. Rather than relying on a billion-dollar cleanroom to protect every cubic foot of factory space, Cleanpipe creates a controlled environment only where cleanliness actually matters: around the wafer.

Talos cleans the tools. Cleanpipe connects them. Eventually, we delete the cleanroom and build more advanced chips, at greater scale, with radically less infrastructure. With cleanpipes connecting tools, chip fabs can exist anywhere.

name: Hundred
description:
Hundred is an automated inspection system for the components that make up devices like phones, smartwatches, and laptops. Hundred helps factories cut waste and prevent line-down issues by catching sub-100µm visual defects before parts reach the assembly line. 

Designs change so fast that traditional machine vision can't keep up, forcing factories to rely on manual inspection, literally people checking parts under microscopes to sort out bad parts. Human inspectors miss roughly 15% of defects, and a single bad part can turn a finished device into scrap. Hundred is replacing manual inspection with an imaging rig that scans an entire shipping tray of parts at once. 

The Hundred rig blocks ambient light and uses varied controlled lighting configurations to detect defects smaller than 100µm on a range of materials. The controlled environment means Hundred only needs to scan a single good part before it can find defects, categorize them, and assess their severity accurately.

Defects cost U.S. discrete manufacturers $45 billion a year, a problem Hundred's CEO, Erica, saw firsthand as a mechanical engineer designing devices at Meta, Google, and Magic Leap. She met Imani, Hundred's CPO, at Columbia University's admitted-students day in 2017 and Imani went on to spend five years at Twitch building software that handles billions of requests a day. Erica later met Iris, Hundred's CTO, in the Bay Area. Iris worked as a quant at Citadel before pivoting to study at Imperial College London where she researched machine learning on 3D meshes and other structured data. Together, they're building Hundred because manual inspection shouldn't still exist in 2026.
verticals: Hard Tech, Hardware, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Industrial

name: Kairox Systems
description:
Kairox Systems combines the speed of aerial drones and the stealth of underwater drones into one vehicle. We can look for mines in a strait, fly out of the water to inspect a coastline, and then engage maritime threats in one go. 

Joel, Alex, and Jorge all met at MIT. After conversations with warfighters and drone researchers, they decided to create a vehicle unlike any before: A long-range vehicle that is truly amphibious, low-cost enough for one-way swarms, can operate fully autonomously, and can be repurposed on the front lines. Engaged with the Marine Corps and validated with end users across the U.S. and allied militaries.

name: Applied Electrodynamics, Inc.
description: Applied Electrodynamics builds imaging systems that see through solid matter. Our team previously co-invented the iPhone touchscreen and Nest learning thermostat. We’re starting in construction, helping teams map structural elements and utilities inside walls and ceilings. The same platform extends to security screening and cargo inspection. Our mission is to make the hidden physical world machine-readable across the entire electromagnetic spectrum.
verticals: Hard Tech, Hardware, Construction, Manufacturing, Defense

name: Roma
description:
Roma is the to-do list that does itself. Two of our three founders have been through YC before: Jan built Loom (W12, acquired by Dropbox) and Tobi built Senic (S13, acquired by Gira).

Most of the work we do starts and ends with a task. So we're rebuilding something everyone already uses: the to-do list that becomes your everyday assistant, the one place that already knows everything you need done.

name: Neomatter
description: Neomatter is a harness for in-house legal teams that integrates into communication channels like email and slack so it can complete the legal work before reaching the lawyer.

name: Silica
description: Silica makes the first affordable actuators that sense forces directly, so that all robots can feel the world around them.

name: Micora
description: Micora re-designed the process of building solar farms to optimize speed to power generation and portability. The product suite combines a palletized solar block, a containerized energy storage system, and low-cost autonomous robots that deploy a solar farm on-site in days to weeks – and pack it back up when needed.

name: OneTriangle
description:
OneTriangle optimizes prefill, speeding up TTFT 10x utilizing KV cache transfer tech

We integrate with your dedicated endpoints, or GPUs to speed up inference.

name: STASIS
description: The WHOOP for 16 billion eyes
verticals: Hardware, Sports Tech, Consumer Health Services, Health & Wellness

name: Versine
description:
Versine lets your agents send and receive money. We’re Venmo for agents.

Connect it to ChatGPT, Claude, Muse or your own agent through our MCP. Then send your agent a dinner receipt and it splits the bill. Tell it “if I don’t run 10k tomorrow, pay Jake $10” and it checks Strava and pays out if you miss. It can also pay invoices that land in your inbox, or split rent and utilities with your roommates every month. 

Recipients don’t need an account: they get a link to cash out to their bank.

Banking and payout services are provided by licensed partners.
verticals: Fintech, Consumer, Consumer Finance, Neobank, AI

name: Mantle
description:
Mantle is a full-stack field service company that deploys, fixes and maintains machines for the companies that build them. We're not a marketplace or software tool, we own uptime directly to provide better, more reliable service without burdening your engineers on support calls. 

$500B+ a year is spent to keep machines running in the US, we're coming for all of it.

name: Quippy
description: Quippy is a daily practice app for your social life. You run short, realistic practice conversations, like pushing back on a boss or talking during a first date, and get line-by-line feedback on what landed and what backfired. The curriculum adapts to each person's patterns, reshaping itself around their weak spots, ensuring steady improvement in the conversations that matter most.

name: Fleety
description: A typical customer handles 100+ jobs a day, with their best technician generating $500,000 more revenue than the average. Fleety listens to every call and automatically routes each job to the technician most likely to generate the most revenue.

name: Jinko
description: Travel Search & Booking Infrastructure for AI agents

name: Ageospatial
description:
Ageospatial helps organizations value the risk on their physical assets (properties, land, infrastructure) remotely using satellite imagery.

97% of commercial properties are never physically inspected because it's too slow and expensive. So insurers price risk based on what the client or broker tells them, and about half the time at least one of those records is wrong. The result is mispricing, fraud, and an estimated $36B in premium leakage every year in the US alone, which gets exposed the moment a disaster hits.

Upload a list of addresses and their GeoAI reads satellite and street-level imagery, maps, real-time data, public records and the insurer's own data to determine what's really there, which natural and human hazards surround it, what changed over time, and which properties are worth inspecting. Each property becomes a living record that underwriting, claims and pricing teams can trace from past to present. Ageospatial deploys inside carriers and MGAs as an AI-native service, so insurers get outcomes delivered.

name: Elithia
description:
US workers' compensation paid out $64.1 billion in 2023. Personal injury, malpractice, and other insurance claims add billions more. Behind every one of these claims sit thousands of pages of medical records, and a clinician spends hours or days reading them to reconstruct what happened to the patient.

Elithia is building agents to do this work.

Our agents reconstruct patient histories, reason across conflicting evidence, and produce defensible analyses, with every finding cited to the original record.

We've sold to physician expert witnesses and medical-legal firms, turning thousands of pages into court-ready chronologies an expert can verify in minutes. Next: TPAs and insurers, where the same review sits behind every injury claim.
verticals: Health Tech, B2B, LegalTech, Insurance, AI

name: Decent
description: Decent is a health insurance brokerage for small businesses. We compare every way to cover your team, show what each one costs, and then keep improving your plan all year. We're paid by insurance companies, so we're free to you.
verticals: Fintech, Health Tech, B2B, Health Insurance, AI

name: Shielded
description: Shielded connects companies’ internal and external data to map market shifts, tariffs, and disruptions directly to suppliers, products, and margins. We turn those impacts into real-time decisions that grow and protect the business.
verticals: Fintech, Supply Chain, Agriculture, Energy, Infrastructure

name: Inflection Space Systems
description: Inflection is building the industrial capacity to manufacture tens of thousands of spacecraft per year for next generation commercial and government space applications. Imagine a factory that looks like an Amazon fulfillment center instead of a NASA clean room.
verticals: Hard Tech, Hardware, Satellites, Manufacturing, Defense

name: Particularity
description: Agentic case sourcing: proactively find violations of consumer protection statutes in public data and prepackage cases for regulators

name: Lucebox
description: Lucebox makes workstations for local AI inference. They're private, always-on machines that arrive with Lucebox's inference engine installed and tuned, so developers point Claude Code, Codex or OpenCode on their own hardware. Lucebox is building toward a new category of self-improving personal AI computers that learn from the work you do every day, training small models on your own context until they're faster and better than the cloud at your tasks. The engine is open source, with 2.9K stars on GitHub and 95K+ downloads on Hugging Face.

name: Edgerun
description: Edgerun builds military exoskeletons. Read the mission at edgerun.com/mission

name: DataNode
description: DataNode is building the structuring data layer for event risk. Our engine combines prediction markets with traditional derivatives to quantify and risk assess any event exposure and build a priced, tailored hedge, even before a market for it exists.

name: Plyxl
description: Plyxl is the workspace that molds to your business. It builds apps, creates automations, and works across your entire company.

name: Super Powers Mobility (SPM)
description:
We started off building the highest performance, 470 volt electric off-road vehicles but we realized our ultra power dense battery packs are useful for mobile and stationary energy storage and power export, for military and consumer use cases. We develop battery packs, power electronics, and traction powertrain systems for vehicles.

For the majority of 2026 we were marketing our electric off-road vehicles, but we pivoted to selling our high performance battery packs and power export capabilities in the month of September. We went from having $769,000 in consumer pre-orders (possibly low conversion rate to sales) to $421,815 in realized revenue in 1 month, with a $792,000 qualified pipeline. 

Our tech is so compelling because the safety and layout of high voltage battery packs has only been mastered by large, well funded OEM companies who have brought it in-house. That means all other companies without the in-house expertise rely on battery companies to develop packs, and power electronics companies to develop power export capabilities. SPM has both of those capabilities in-house so we can ensure a fast turnaround and much more reliable product. 

One of the biggest priorities of the department of war is energy dominance. We're seeing it constantly in new solicitations. Our strategy is superior - become a prime, but simultaneously service primes because most of then don't actually have the battery and power electronics expertise we have.

Founded by Jon Powers - Ex-Tesla Sr. Mechanical Integration Engineer leading Cybertruck vehicle integration.
verticals: Energy Storage, Unmanned Vehicle, Manufacturing, Electric Vehicles, Electronics

name: Vouch
description:
Vouch is the new-age wealth manager for India’s young and ambitious professionals, with no minimums. India’s wealth industry is antiquated: great help starts at Rs 5 crore, and everyone else is left with a local agent or a trading app. Vouch’s AI agents, trained by experienced wealth managers, are filling the void: they plan your money, act on it once you approve, and keep it on track.

Indians are getting wealthier and moving that wealth into markets: $2.37 trillion in new financial wealth by 2030, and stocks and mutual funds up from 2% to 15% of household savings since 2012. At Vouch, we're starting with mutual funds before growing into the one place this burgeoning, new India manages its money.

name: Kairos Health
description:
Kairos Health automates patient engagement for dentists by handling phones and insurance.

Kairos plugs into a dental practice's software, calls patients who are overdue for care, and books them directly into the schedule. It also answers every inbound call 24/7 and verifies insurance.

Our mission is to put practice operations on autopilot and keep every chair filled.

name: Audora
description:
Audora turns your book or story into an audiobook where every character has their own voice.

The best adaptation of a book is the one in your head. You can see the characters in front of you and hear them talking to each other. We want an audiobook to do those characters justice: a voice that fits each of them, so a conversation actually sounds like a conversation.

Paste a story link or upload a file. Audora works out who’s speaking and gives each character a distinct voice alongside the narrator. You can start listening while the rest of the book is still being made.

Our roots are in fanfiction. We’re building for readers who already know these characters by heart, with a focus on voices that capture their personalities and stay consistent throughout the story.

Try Audora: https://audora.art
Watch the demo: https://youtu.be/R6Pt2O0fD4c

name: Evergrove
description:
We've built voice agents for the largest work comp managed care orgs and specialist PT networks in the country, making >500K calls annually and accelerating the speed at which they coordinate care. On average, our customers see a 40% increase in workflow completion, 10x decrease in cycle times, and >60% reduction in cost.

We think voice agents are the starting point for solving slow and fragmented care coordination in this market. Companies that manage an injured worker's care rely on short-staffed contact centres and archaic methods of info exchange: phone, fax, and email. Every delay along the path of care leads to slower rehab of the injured worker, lower throughput for providers, and higher expense for the insurer/employer.

name: Osseus
description: Osseus is building the frontier biomedical AI research lab, starting with the evaluations, reinforcement learning environments, and datasets that help AI labs train more capable, aligned, and safe models. We post-train models for medical and biological tasks, and deploy these in biotech, pharma and healthcare systems to ultimately improve patient outcomes.
verticals: B2B, Biotech, Healthcare, Data Engineering, AI

name: Lux Foods
description: Lux Foods engineers ultra-compact plants that produce mostly fruit, then grows them on sugar with 90% less light. We design the biology and hardware together to make robotic farming easier. Starting with cherry tomatoes, we’re building year-round production of flavorful, nutritious, pesticide-free fruit near the people who eat it. Our tomatoes have been grown on the International Space Station, and now we're taking this technology to Earth.
verticals: Cellular Agriculture, Robotics, Manufacturing, Agriculture, Biotechnology

name: Composal
description: Composal gives engineers always-on agents that work in the cloud, each with its own computer, Slack handle and memory. An engineer gives one a standing order, like “watch Sentry, fix new errors, get the fix reviewed and ship it,” and it keeps going after the laptop closes. Our QA agents test every pull request by using the app like a real user, and have found over 1,500 bugs in customers’ apps since mid-October.
verticals: Developer Tools, DevSecOps, Cloud Computing, AI

name: Mass Magnetics
description:
Mass Magnetics turns recycled rare-earth scrap into high-performance permanent magnets, made in America. The materials we supply are the backbone of electric motors, sensors, speakers, hard drives, and electronics.
Our process enables DFARS-compliant magnets for defense, aerospace, and industrial manufacturers who demand domestic supply without compromising on quality.
Operations in Greater Boston, MA (Greentown Labs) and Columbus, IN.
verticals: Hard Tech, Robotics, Drones, Manufacturing, Defense

name: Gutgutgoose
description:
Most data companies pay for their data. Ours pays for itself.
Customers send us a stool sample. We sequence it, build a metabolic model of that gut, and simulate whether each probiotic strain has an open niche it can colonize. We formulate the best candidates, then re-sequence 90 days later to see what actually took hold and what changed. Each cycle gives us the baseline gut, the intervention, and the outcome. At scale, the endgame is models that predict chronic disease years before symptoms.

name: Spine
description:
Spine runs benefits, payroll, and compliance for startups for free.

We do the work by giving teams dedicated senior HR and benefits specialists who operate on top of their existing HRIS (Rippling, Deel, Gusto, ADP). We help companies find better-fit, more cost-effective health plans - reducing healthcare costs by around 15% on average - while running payroll, handling compliance, managing open enrollment, and supporting employees directly in Slack.

30+ startups already use Spine to lower healthcare costs and take hours of back-office work off their teams. Learn more at joinspine.ai or email onur@joinspine.ai

name: Kara
description:
Kara is building diamond semiconductors. 

We begin with growing ultra-high purity diamond wafers for advanced hardware. Used in data centers, spacecrafts, RF systems, and quantum hardware, our diamond moves heat up to 5× better than copper, helping critical systems run cooler, faster, and more reliably. 

Diamond has spent centuries as a symbol. We are turning it into infrastructure.

name: Frontier Computing
description:
Frontier is first to grow biological brains at scale, serving biological neural nets with substrate-level colocation of memory and compute, enabling highly cost effective training of large parameter count models.

While academia has traditionally been limited to ~1M neurons in vitro, Frontier has built a pathway to scale to 100M+ neurons by circumventing traditional scaling challenges in biological culture, demonstrating this strategy's functionality by training a biological brain using this scaling primitive to play Frogger.

Frontier is now growing exascale compute clusters to produce substrates capable of long-horizon language reasoning while operating at much higher sample efficiencies than traditional architectures, and collocating memory with compute to enable significantly larger parameter counts than would be tractable for training within traditional compute clusters.

name: Liquid Energy
description:
Liquid Energy delivers the most scalable and cost effective inference. Our compute is hosted in our proprietary data center modules that we call NanoDC - the Nano Data Center. 

NanoDC is engineered to be rapidly deployable and scalable without traditional bottlenecks like power, permitting, and supply chains. Using NanoDC, Liquid Energy is able to provide the most efficient and sustainable way to scale compute to meet global AI demand.

We have 20 units and have spent the last year in building the supply chain and manufacturing, because of that we have an ability to manufacture 2 MW/month. Over the next year we will scale that up to 20MW per month.
verticals: Hard Tech, Solar Power, Energy, AI

name: Theseus Robotics
description: Theseus Robotics creates the OS & Physical AI to deploys humanoids to automate menial tasks in supermarkets. During the day, our robotics pick orders for e-grocery orders. Overnight, they restocks shelves with goods from the back warehouse.

name: tash
description:
tash is building the investment platform for sports and trading cards. We create professionally constructed portfolios of iconic, investment-grade cards, giving investors exposure to the asset class without the hassle of selecting, buying, storing, and selling individual cards.

Trading card investing remains fragmented, opaque, and difficult to access. tash is building the infrastructure to make the asset class simpler, more transparent, and professionally managed. We are currently pursuing SEC qualification to launch regulated investment offerings backed by trading cards.

name: Viraj Aero
description:
Viraj Aero builds gas turbines that deliver both power and cooling water for data centers. It needs no grid connection and no water pipeline.

Burning natural gas already produces water. Our patented system captures that water from the exhaust. Part of it cools the data center. The rest is turned into steam and injected back into the turbine. That gives up to 40% more power from the same fuel (cheaper compute) and cuts NOx emissions by up to 99%, which cuts permit approvals from years to weeks.

We're building a genset around our first-of-its-kind gas turbine. It fits in a 10-foot container and runs anywhere, even in the desert. That matters because two-thirds of new data centers are being built in water-stressed regions.

We first built this steam-injected turbine for aircraft, where carrying water tanks isn't an option and efficiency is critical. We're currently integrating our full-scale prototype into an aircraft. The team comes from GE, Rolls-Royce and Formula 1, and we're already working with Safran, one of the world's largest aircraft engine manufacturers.

name: Adalat AI
description: AI OS transforming courts, accelerating justice

name: EveryApp
description: EveryApp is building open source alternatives to every SaaS. It’s a platform to host these open source apps and personal software. Everything runs behind one secure sign-in in your own Cloudflare account.

name: RouterPlus
description:
RouterPlus is a marketplace for AI inference. We find the right AI model for a team's product, then get it served at the team's scale, at the best price.

Most teams that run AI in production pay for a top model on every task, when a cheaper model can do most of the work. The same model can also cost twice as much depending on which provider runs it, and many providers fail at peak traffic.

RouterPlus tests models on a team's own traffic and recommends one. Providers then compete for the workload. We check that the chosen provider can hold the team's real peak, and we keep a second provider ready as a backup. Teams call the model through one API.

Our largest customer runs 3 million agent conversations a day on RouterPlus.

name: Sinter
description: Sinter is a radically faster plastics pipeline, helping iteration heavy hardware teams evolve from prototypes to production parts on week-scale timelines.

name: Boat
description:
**Problem**

Humans used to need laptops to do their work. Now they prompt agents instead, and those agents need computers too: always-on, in large quantities, and with unlimited capabilities. 

Building and maintaining that yourself is far from trivial.

**Solution**

Boat provides powerful, simple, permissive Ubuntu VMs in the cloud. In a sandbox, an agent can work for long periods on code or on knowledge work like legal, research, reporting, and auditing.

**Why Boat and not any other cloud VM?**

1. It is ready out of the box: every sandbox ships with a desktop, chrome, languages, docker, snapshots, and templates, plus a CLI, SDK, API, and control pane for your fleet.
2. It is permissive and paradigm agnostic: any number of agents can use any number of sandboxes. Agents can run inside or use sandboxes as an external tool.
3. It is expertly crafted: we manage everything from the individual CPU to the orchestration software, which makes sandboxes stable, persistent, scalable, and secure.
4. It is the best performance and price in town: our CPUs rank first on HPC benchmarks, and sandboxes are typically 9x to 18x cheaper than other leading sandboxes.

**Further notes**

Sandboxes are hosted in Europe, which keeps prices low, and more regions are coming. Unless compliance requires it, agents don't notice the region they run in.

name: Sintropix
description:
Sintropix is a financial system of record that closes your books every day and files your taxes in every country you operate in.

We connect to your banks, invoicing and payroll, and handle the accounting end-to-end. Founders get one place to do their finance work: track KPIs, see consolidated P&L and ARR reports, and forecast runway.

name: Godpack
description: The marketplace for internet culture.

name: Asakana
description: Restaurants send orders to food distributors by email, text, and photo. Someone at the distributor retypes every one of them into the ERP. Asakana does that entry instead: orders land in the ERP already entered, and anything unclear goes to a person before it goes in. Live at US seafood distributors today, returning 40%+ of order-desk time to selling. Founded by a seafood distributor and a Gemini builder.

name: Palisade
description: Palisade spins up a personal sales agent for every single visitor to your website. Marketplaces like trading card platforms, vintage stores, and short-term rental operators sell more when each customer works with a personal agent that remembers them.

name: Zaplar
description:
Zaplar is the AI-native operating system for hotels.

Hotels run on legacy software and a fragmented tech stack. Zaplar replaces the entire hotel tech stack (PMS, POS, booking engine, etc) with one software that can handle hotel operations autonomously.

Learn more at https://zaplar.com

name: Central Blue
description:
Spacecraft today have to generate all their own power, which caps what can be built and operated in orbit. Central Blue is building the power grid for space: satellites that collect sunlight and beam power by laser to receiver panels on other spacecraft.

Our first power-beaming prototype is nearly complete in Seattle, with a laser-powered propulsion demonstration planned with Wave Motion Launch Technologies. Our CORE software will let the power satellites detect faults and recover on their own, keeping the grid running around the clock.

name: PRINCEPS
description: PRINCEPS is the first purpose-built insurance company for the trillion-dollar compute buildout. We underwrite SLA, GPU residual value, and outage risk, and price the coverage that unlocks cheaper financing for data centers and neoclouds.

name: Munito AI
description:
Munito is an open-model inference provider for Europe, private by default. Its API lets users choose their models and keep inference and storage in the EU. 
Founded by the former inference lead at Mistral AI, Munito is built on one belief: open and independent intelligence, both models and inference, is key to economic growth and prosperity.

name: Verdict Machine
description:
Verdict Machine uses AI to understand each financial institution's complete on-chain environment, assess its cyber risk and generate tailored controls. The same live model powers transaction prevention, continuous cyber diligence, security posture and cost-efficient wallet screening. Before execution, Verdict Machine evaluates proposed transactions against the institution's active policies.

In our first weeks, we started POCs with asset managers and digital-asset infrastructure providers whose systems move billions of dollars every week for financial institutions. We're now in active evaluations with digital-asset teams at some of the world's largest banks.

The founding team launched and led blockchain security at Check Point (NASDAQ: CHKP).

name: Keres
description: Keres (KAIR-eez) builds reusable unmanned jet interceptors for air defense. The Garmur launches on cue, closes at jet speed, positively identifies and kills drones and cruise missiles, then lands to fly again. It gives commanders a fighter-class response at a fraction of the cost.

name: BioDelivera
description: BioDelivera has developed proprietary GCV™, a drug delivery platform designed to travel through the body and selectively target diseased cells while sparing healthy ones. GCVs can carry genetic medicines, DNA, RNA, small molecules, or combinations of these at the same time. BioDelivera has demonstrated efficacy in tumors, muscle, and brain and is expanding to additional tissues. The company’s mission is to enable cures for every patient, across every disease.
verticals: Gene Therapy, Drug Delivery, Therapeutics, AI, Biotechnology

name: Saccade
description:
Alzheimer's testing today is bottlenecked around the onset of symptoms, when the damage is already done. Current treatments, including the FDA-approved drugs released in 2024, don't reverse the disease; they only slow it down. Earlier detection means earlier intervention.

Eye movement changes linked to Alzheimer's surface sooner than any other biomarker, up to 15 years before symptoms appear.

We deliver a 15-minute VR assessment delivered to patients in longevity clinics:
• Tasks: patients perform visual tasks designed by neurologists to trigger a distinct oculomotor response in people with Alzheimer's or on its path
• Hardware: our patent-pending attachment connects to any VR headset on the market and captures these eye movement patterns.
• Analysis: the patterns are compared against our ML model to produce a risk analysis.

Once classified, patients can access new interventions, such as the FDA-approved drugs. They're also referred to longevity practices, neurology practices or both, depending on their stage of decline.

Testing for the earliest biomarkers allows the earliest possible intervention. In some cases, that slows the disease enough that patients outlive the onset of symptoms and never face memory loss in their lifetime.
verticals: Hard Tech, Hardware, Machine Learning, B2B, Healthcare

name: Kailash Labs
description:
The world generates petabytes of video every day, and almost none of it is readable to machines.  Frontier VLMs that can unlock this (like Gemini) are too expensive to run at the volume real industries have, too generic for any single task, and can't be deployed on-prem where sensitive video lives.

We are building an auto vision factory: take video plus a customer's objective, distill a frontier model, and post-train a small open model that is SOTA on that one task and serve it blazingly fast. Our first product, Marlin, is a 2B-parameter open-weights video VLM that matches Gemini-2.5-flash on dense captioning and temporal grounding at a fraction of the cost.

name: Colony
description: Long-range drone network for world data collection

name: CONUS
description:
CONUS structures fragmented medical device information for surgeons. We combine manufacturer documentation, hospital protocols and medical research in one place, giving surgeons and MedTech teams reliable answers across products and procedures through search and source-backed AI.

We already work with leading manufacturers including Johnson & Johnson, Stryker and Zimmer Biomet, and since launching six months ago we’ve gone live in 27 hospitals, with 49 more onboarding.

Long term, hospitals will use CONUS to source and order surgical devices across manufacturers.

name: Caution
description:
Caution is a hosting platform for software you can't afford to get hacked. It simplifies and extends confidential compute, and lets developers deploy workloads to secure enclaves in minutes and give customers, auditors, and counterparties cryptographic proof that production is running the exact reviewed source code, build, configuration, and runtime - not an opaque binary controlled by a cloud operator or internal admin.

Confidential computing hardware exists, but the tooling is too fragmented and incomplete for most teams to use well. Today, attestation often proves only that a binary has a certain hash; it does not prove what source code produced that binary. Building the missing deployment, reproducibility, and verification layer requires specialized security engineering and often locks teams into one cloud or hardware stack. Caution turns that into a simple git-based workflow that builds reproducible enclave images, provisions infrastructure, and lets anyone independently verify what is running.

We built Caution after years securing high-risk systems through Distrust, where we worked with hedge funds, custodians, blockchain teams, cloud platforms, and critical grid operators on systems responsible for more than $600B in assets. Again and again, the same problem showed up: teams running mission-critical infrastructure could not reliably prove what was executing in production.

As AI, fintech, healthcare, and regulated data collaboration move into the cloud, "trust us" is no longer enough. Caution is a general-purpose platform: if it runs on a server, it can run verifiably on Caution. We're starting where trust failures cost the most, but we believe verifiable compute will become the default way software runs, the same way HTTPS became the default way it's served. Infrastructure you can verify, not trust.

name: Fire Wallet
description:
