name: Ascenix
description:
Ascenix is building one custom interface for running senior homes. We combine reusable building blocks into workflows tailored to each home's existing processes, from incident reporting to reimbursement. Homes get custom software without hiring an engineering team.

Living in a retirement home convinced us that the best way to improve residents' lives is to improve the systems staff rely on. As the older population grows, care teams need more time and resources. Repetitive reporting, missed reimbursement, and compliance problems take those away. Disconnected products that solve each of these individually add costs and leave staff moving information between systems.

Our building blocks gather information from EHRs like PointClickCare and other sources, process it, apply rules, and produce reports, tasks, or emails. Incident reporting and reimbursement reviews usually come from two separate vendors. Ascenix builds both from the same blocks, in one interface, so data isn't stuck in silos. Homes start with their biggest bottleneck and add workflows as priorities change.

name: Lumeria
description: The Lumoscope is a multispectral camera that clips onto your phone and scans your skin at home with the same light used in clinics. You see what a mirror can't: a breakout days before it surfaces, and wrinkles changing over time. Our software then reads that history, connects flare-ups to causes you'd never suspect, and matches products to what your own data shows works.
verticals: Consumer Health Services, Health Tech, Health & Wellness, Skincare, AI

name: Nuum Robotics
description: Snake-like robots for maintenance inside machinery.

name: Waybill
description:
Hardware teams burn weeks on procurement. An engineer needs a part. Someone emails five distributors, chases quotes, gets an approval, wires the money, tracks a shipment across three carriers, clears customs, and then nobody knows where the box is or what's actually on the shelf.

Waybill runs that entire loop. Send us a part, a spec, or a BOM. We source it, pull quotes, route approvals, pay the supplier, handle freight and customs, track it to your dock, and keep your stock count updated. 

Take your supply chain for granted.

Built by a team that's seen it at LAT Aerospace and WareIQ (YC S20).

name: Raven
description:
Phones were made to run apps. Raven is made for the world of agents. It is where you send your agents from, and where they report back.

Pre-order at ravenphone.com

name: Grip
description: Grip is a robotics company building intelligent robotic systems for waste and recycling. We are starting with organic waste, where removing contaminants from messy, constantly changing streams remains difficult and highly manual. Our technology combines learning-based manipulation and custom hardware to identify and pick objects, learning from real-world operating data, including every successful and failed grasp, to become more reliable and adaptable over time. This helps waste operators reduce manual sorting, recover more valuable material, lower contamination, and deploy automation flexibly across facilities. Over time, Grip aims to expand beyond organics and build the intelligent manipulation layer for trash in general, making waste processing and the circular economy more efficient and scalable.

name: Nitroduck
description: We make gene editing easy for all crops. To make pesticides obsolete across vegetables and fruits, enabling coffee to withstand heat waves, making almonds independent of pollinators, pistachios independent of winter chill, and much more. To let breeders create novel, consumer-facing crop varieties like pink pineapples, seedless cherries, and non-browning avocados.

name: Bear
description: Bear (formerly Last Accounting Company) is a full-stack AI accounting firm. We sell the same service (bookkeeping, tax filings, etc.) as a traditional accounting firm, but underneath agents handle everything and a certified accountant signs off. Our service is faster, cheaper, and fully integrated, allowing our clients to focus on what matters, not accounting admin.

name: RATLOG
description: Reusable heavy-lift rockets

name: GrayPass
description:
Login tells you who signed in. GrayPass helps apps check who’s behind sensitive actions and whether they’re authorized before those actions go through.

It combines identity, device and session context with behavioral signals like typing rhythm, cursor movement and scrolling. Before a sensitive action goes through, GrayPass evaluates that evidence against your team’s policy and returns a decision: allow, challenge, hold or deny. Your app enforces the decision.

This applies to actions like exporting sensitive data, changing admin permissions or allowing an AI agent to act on someone’s behalf. Allowed actions receive short-lived, signed proof tied to the exact action and your app.

Your existing login and authentication stack stays in place.

name: Canos
description:
Canos is bringing a human-grade liquid biopsy platform for dogs, starting with a single blood draw. We sequence cell-free DNA to perform multi-modal analysis of fragmentation, copy number variation, native methylation (5mC and 5hmC) and more to detect cancer signals. Owners bank a healthy baseline for their dog and track changes every year. Dogs already diagnosed get personalized monitoring through treatment. We partner with mobile vets and vet clinics to serve SF and NYC. 

Our mission is to make pet cancer curable through early detection and monitoring.
